_comment: Growth League registry (LANE-RULES R27, tools/league/LEAGUE.md). Canonical. One row per league page; the Monday league run syncs tools/league/manifests/*.json into it (score.mjs --sync) and scores it from the nightly GA4 snapshot (score.mjs). Score = organic-search landing sessions from `published` (floor window from `floorFrom`). Never hand-edit a score; the board is data/league-board.json.

A.name: Release desk
A.thesis: A page for every dated release, built 10+ days before street date; owns data/releases.json rows (dated, sourced, never guessed).

B.name: Question desk
B.thesis: "How much is X worth" / "is Y worth it" pages answered with dated sold comps and the index the card sits in.

C.name: Comparison desk
C.thesis: "X vs Y" pages (ETB vs box, set vs set, Bowman vs Bowman Chrome) decided on index levels and dated sold marks.
